description: This PHP source file defines the class GitlabIdentityProviderException, which extends the IdentityProviderException class. It provides static methods to create specific exceptions based on response data received from OAuth2 identity provider interactions, especially tailored for GitLab. The class is part of the Omines\OAuth2\Client\Provider\Exception namespace and interacts with PSR HTTP message response interfaces.

classes.name: GitlabIdentityProviderException
classes.description: Custom exception class for GitLab OAuth2 provider errors, extending the generic IdentityProviderException, with static methods to generate exceptions based on HTTP responses and response data.

methods.name: clientException
methods.description: Creates a client exception from a ResponseInterface and response data, using a message from data if available, otherwise the response's reason phrase.

methods.name: oauthException
methods.description: Creates an OAuth exception from a ResponseInterface and response data, selecting an error message from data if present, otherwise using the response's reason phrase.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Creates an instance of this exception class from a ResponseInterface and an optional message, incorporating the response's status code and body.
